title: Distributive Property & Combining Like Terms
topic: Expanding expressions and simplifying by combining like terms

items.prompt: Use the distributive property to expand 3(x + 5).

choices.A: Like terms, because they share the same coefficient
choices.B: Not like terms, because the variable parts (a and a^2) are different
choices.C: Always equal to the same value
choices.D: Like terms because they both use the letter a

items.rationale: Like terms must have identical variable parts, including the exponent; a and a^2 are different.
